{ff02}Super 27 is 1 coin per game.
This slot has a HOLD Game and
a BONUS Game.{ff01}{ff02}In the HOLD Game, you can HOLD any
reel you want to keep. From the left,
use Square, X and Circle.{ff01}{ff02}But you can't HOLD twice in a row.
When two symbols match, it's smart
to hold them!{ff01}{ff02}The rest is up to you!{ff01}{ff02}Line up symbols on the center line
to win, and you can choose
the BONUS Game.{ff01}{ff02}BONUS is 5 coins per game and
becomes a 27-line game. Top, middle,
bottom: anywhere wins!{ff01}{ff02}But you can't HOLD.{ff01}{ff02}The 6 symbols other than the winning
one when you enter BONUS become
Challenge Symbols.{ff01}{ff02}Their lights show under the reels,
and they go out as you hit them.{ff01}{ff02}It ends when all Challenge Symbols
are out, your WIN coins run out,
or you hit 1000 coins.{ff01}{ff02}The JP symbol wins anywhere, even
outside BONUS. The payout is
random. It's a surprise!{ff01}{ff02}If you don't want BONUS, press Down
to TAKE SCORE! To stop partway,
press L1.{ff01}{ff02}Press R1 to start.
LET'S TRY!!{ff01}
